hooks.command: bash -c 'source ~/Developer/dotfiles/.env 2>/dev/null && PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && SUBAGENT_TYPE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.subagent_type // \"unknown\"") && DESCRIPTION=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.description // \"タスク実行中\"") && curl -X POST https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN" -d "{\"to\":\"$LINE_USER_ID\",\"messages\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"🚀 Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME\nサブエージェント起動: $SUBAGENT_TYPE\n$DESCRIPTION\"}]}" 2>&1 || echo "❌ Hook PreToolUse.subagent-start execution failed" >&2'
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path | select(endswith(".js") or endswith(".ts") or endswith(".jsx") or endswith(".tsx"))' | xargs -r prettier --write

bash -c 'source ~/Developer/dotfiles/.env 2>/dev/null && PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && MESSAGE=$(cat | jq -r ".message // \"通知があります\"") && curl -X POST https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN" -d "{\"to\":\"$LINE_USER_ID\",\"messages\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"🔔 Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME\n$MESSAGE\"}]}" 2>&1 || echo "❌ Hook Notification.notification execution failed" >&2'
bash -c 'PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && MESSAGE=$(cat | jq -r ".message // \"通知があります\"") && ~/Developer/dotfiles/claude/vscode-notify.sh "Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME" "$MESSAGE"'

bash -c 'source ~/Developer/dotfiles/.env 2>/dev/null && PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && INPUT=$(cat) && TRANSCRIPT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".transcript_path // empty") && if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ]; then SUBAGENT_TYPE=$(tac "$TRANSCRIPT" | grep -m1 "subagent_type" | jq -r ".tool_input.subagent_type // \"unknown\"" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); else SUBAGENT_TYPE="unknown"; fi && curl -X POST https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN" -d "{\"to\":\"$LINE_USER_ID\",\"messages\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"✅ Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME\nサブエージェント完了: $SUBAGENT_TYPE\"}]}" 2>&1 || echo "❌ Hook SubagentStop.subagent-end execution failed" >&2'

bash -c 'PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && INPUT=$(cat) && TRANSCRIPT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".transcript_path // empty") && if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ]; then SUBAGENT_TYPE=$(tac "$TRANSCRIPT" | grep -m1 "subagent_type" | jq -r ".tool_input.subagent_type // \"unknown\"" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); else SUBAGENT_TYPE="unknown"; fi && ~/Developer/dotfiles/claude/vscode-notify.sh "Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME" "サブエージェント完了: $SUBAGENT_TYPE"'

bash -c 'source ~/Developer/dotfiles/.env 2>/dev/null && PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && TRANSCRIPT=$(cat | jq -r ".transcript_path // empty") && if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ]; then BASH_COUNT=$(grep -c ""tool":"Bash"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && EDIT_COUNT=$(grep -c ""tool":"Edit"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && WRITE_COUNT=$(grep -c ""tool":"Write"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && READ_COUNT=$(grep -c ""tool":"Read"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && SUMMARY="📊 セッションサマリー:
Bash: ${BASH_COUNT}回
編集: ${EDIT_COUNT}回
作成: ${WRITE_COUNT}回
読取: ${READ_COUNT}回"; else SUMMARY="タスクが完了しました"; fi && curl -X POST https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN" -d "{"to":"$LINE_USER_ID","messages":[{"type":"text","text":"✅ Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME
$SUMMARY"}]}" 2>&1 || echo "❌ Hook Stop.notification execution failed" >&2'

bash -c 'PROJECT_NAME=$(basename $(pwd)) && TRANSCRIPT=$(cat | jq -r ".transcript_path // empty") && if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ]; then BASH_COUNT=$(grep -c "\"tool\":\"Bash\"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && EDIT_COUNT=$(grep -c "\"tool\":\"Edit\"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && WRITE_COUNT=$(grep -c "\"tool\":\"Write\"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && READ_COUNT=$(grep -c "\"tool\":\"Read\"" "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && SUMMARY="完了 Bash:${BASH_COUNT} Edit:${EDIT_COUNT} Write:${WRITE_COUNT} Read:${READ_COUNT}"; else SUMMARY="タスクが完了しました"; fi && ~/Developer/dotfiles/claude/vscode-notify.sh "Claude Code - $PROJECT_NAME" "$SUMMARY"'
